findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_mev_feed · Private data: submit_bundle · Public sink: submit_bundle, recommend_bundle_submission, get_daily_liquidation_report, build_liquidation_tx · Destructive: get_liquidation_waves.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_mev_feed · Private data: submit_bundle · Public sink: submit_bundle, recommend_bundle_submission, get_daily_liquidation_report, build_liquidation_tx · Destructive: get_liquidation_waves

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
